description: This Java class 'MacroCommonRenderer' provides utility methods for rendering macros in the OFBiz widget framework. It includes methods for creating AJAX parameter strings from update areas, analyzing links to resolve URLs based on context, and building parameter strings. The code interacts with various OFBiz utility classes and models related to widgets, forms, and web requests.

classes.name: MacroCommonRenderer
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for rendering macros, creating AJAX parameters, and resolving link URLs within the OFBiz widget framework.

methods.name: createAjaxParamsFromUpdateAreas
methods.description: Generates a JavaScript CSV string for AJAX update areas based on a list of update area objects, including context and extra parameters.

methods.name: buildParamStringFromMap
methods.description: Constructs a URL-encoded parameter string from a map of parameters.

methods.name: getLinkUrl
methods.description: Determines the URL to use for a given link object based on its type and current execution context.
